visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Expected Sum Overflows
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For the numbers 0 to 100000 with 77777 missing, the program should print 77777 but prints -4294889519.

solution.explanation: n * (n + 1) is calculated with ints, and 100000 * 100001 is larger than the biggest int, so it wraps around before the result is widened to long. Casting one operand to long first makes the multiplication use 64 bits.
